meta.author: claude
meta.description: Well, level 1 of 3: shell and fittings (what soldiers build first). Round stone well sunk into the ground: a one-course round cobblestone rim round a pool, dark oak posts and windlass with a chain; L2 adds the spruce gable roof, crank, pulley and a lantern, L3 a water tub, a flower pot, moss and lanterns. 5 x 5 x 7 (one layer in the ground), water by the decoration step. Decoration step adds: water.
meta.changes: For your note: the rim is now ONE block tall. The well is sunk into the ground (the water is level with the grass, inside a stone lining) and only one course of stone stands above it. Rounder: the corner stairs are gone (grass there now), the rim is a thin round ring and the pool inside is bigger. Posts, roof, windlass and the per-level extras stay; poppies by the rim on level 1, a flower pot on the barrel on level 3.
